acceptance: Owner decision recorded on whether --non-interactive should count; if yes, a test shows the gate refuses with the flag in a terminal.
Dry run and real run treat an invalid driver_version consistently, or the difference is documented.
context: Found while delivering PR #4227. Guardrails: work in a linked worktree (make worktree-create, then make agent-write-preflight); never edit the primary clone. Related items share one feature branch and PR where their files overlap. No live-cloud runs and no credentials in Git or logs; heavy work only through lock-taking entry points or make heavy-run after make heavy-status. Follow the comment policy and add a changelog.d fragment for user-facing changes. Re-verify every cited file and line before acting; they are hints. Stop and report rather than widen scope.
description: Problem: the driver auto-install gate added in PR #4227 detects non-interactive sessions from the terminal and BENCHBOX_NON_INTERACTIVE only, so `run --non-interactive` in a terminal still installs without the environment variable. Also, a dry run with an invalid driver_version only warns and continues, while a real run exits 2.
